correctness.rationale: Every possible labeled transition relation of cardinality 0 to 8 among 32 edges is enumerated. Reachability BFS exhausts the finite subset graph. All masks with 0 through 7 edges fail to reach 16. Exactly 5808 at eight edges reach all 16, and pairwise distinguishability and independently implemented partition refinement both give 56544 fully minimal choices of final sets. An explicit eight-edge witness and a second independent executable provide reproducible finite proof.

value.rationale: The minimum transition-edge budget permitting full determinization blowup is a motivated resource measure. The sharp first four-state boundary combines a matching sparse witness, exact exclusion of every smaller transition budget, and an exhaustive census of all extremal transition relations and accepting masks. It supplies a finite benchmark beyond the previously observed three-state spectrum without claiming a general state-size result.
